name: CHEST LOW-DOSE
content:
EXAM:  CT OF THE CHEST WITHOUT IV CONTRAST 

HISTORY:   High-risk patient


COMPARISON: None

TECHNIQUE: Low dose CT of the chest was performed.  Coronal and sagittal reformats were obtained from the axial data set.

IV Contrast: None

FINDINGS:

AIRWAY/THYROID: The airway is patent.  No thyromegaly.

AORTA/VASCULAR: No aortic aneurysm.

LUNGS:  No suspicious pulmonary nodules seen.  

MEDIASTINUM:  There is no cardiomegaly.  There is no pericardial effusion. 

PLEURA:   No pleural effusion or pneumothorax seen.  

HILAR STRUCTURES: No bulky hilar adenopathy by unenhanced examination.  
 
AXILLARY: No bulky axillary adenopathy.  

OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:  Underlying osseous structures no significant abnormality. 


UPPER ABDOMEN:   Limited by low dose technique.
 
IMPRESSION:

[]

Note:
Low-dose CT is nondiagnostic for soft tissue details.

Recommedations: 

[]
prompt:
1. any pulmonary nodules please less than in the lungs section and remove the statement "No suspicious pulmonary nodules seen. "

2.  include DLP if given in the input and placed under contrast field.

3. include recommendations if given. 

4. include sentences in impression if given. 

5. Move IMPRESSION statement above the FINDINGS statement.

6. Add DLP as DLP (mGy-cm): [] if given.
